test_cases.title: Open the database workspace
test_cases.expected: The workspace opens and lists available tables.
test_cases.actual: The workspace opened and displayed the Tables page.

test_cases.title: Understand the resource type from the table card
test_cases.expected: The table card displays a meaningful resource type.
test_cases.actual: The table card displays the literal value undefined.

attempts.notes: The same value remained after a serial reload.

findings.title: Table card displays undefined as its resource type
findings.expected: The card displays a resource type such as Multimodal.
findings.actual: The card displays the literal value undefined.
findings.impact: Users cannot identify the table type and the resource list appears broken.
findings.recommendation: Render the resolved table type and use an explicit fallback label when metadata is unavailable.
